title: Fix GST rounding
ask: Our add_gst function in pricing.py is a cent short on some prices. A $10.05 item should come to $11.06 with GST and we charge $11.05. Please fix it; the tests are in tests/test_pricing.py.
background: Prices are held in whole cents, which was meant to avoid exactly this.
The accountant spotted it when the till total and the ledger disagreed by a few cents.
Nothing else in the file needs to change.

constraints.text: keep the add_gst function to 6 lines or fewer
no line in pricing.py longer than 88 characters
write a short note on the fix and save it as NOTES.md
put type hints on every argument and the return value of add_gst
use whole-number arithmetic only in pricing.py, so no float( and no decimal points
use the words "root cause" in the notes
no exclamation marks in the notes
run the tests with python3 -m unittest before you finish
link the issue, https://issues.kettleandco.example/212, in the notes
